title: Streaming prefix scan for group aggregate rollups
scope: database body and benchmark evidence only
summary: Group aggregate fast path now streams visible prefix rows through a transaction visitor instead of allocating a full Vec of key-value pairs before aggregation.

trend_vs_benchprod043.note: TSBS is the intended improvement. Remaining regressions are unrelated micro-case noise or pre-existing LDBC/search variance requiring separate tasks.
